full_details: Morning prayer at St Helen's, with Master Thwaite promising fourteen heads and the sixpence for firing running on till Lady Day. At four the letter from the twenty-seventh was still at the board. The children's news is in the first ink. Under it, in a darker ink, your father has a reckoning of fourteen shillings and sixpence at the whittawer's. The first answer was harsher than that bill, and you burned it in the candle. The one you kept asks Anne to judge what the house must pay before you come. It names no day. It is not sent. Nothing was paid.
one_sentence: You read Anne's letter again, found your father's 14s 6d at the whittawer's that you had skipped at the Bell, and burned the sharp answer.
title: Read the postscript and burned the sharp letter
